The main takeaway from our work is that
UL24 is not required for viral replication but instead plays a role in the dissemination of viral infection from epithelial cells to neuronal cells in the cornea.
the role of UL24 in the pathogenesis of HSV-1 infection is not due to a defect in the release of virus from the cornea, but rather to an effect on the ability of the virus to infect neurons in TG.
